_comment: REFERENCE COPY of the intended branch protection for main on {{GITHUB_ORG}}/{{ENGAGEMENT_SLUG}}. Applying or changing branch protection or rulesets is a human repo-admin act, never an agent's: see TEMPLATE.md. required_status_checks lists the eight jobs of validate.yml, which run on every pull request to main; validate-frontmatter.yml and scan-plugins.yml are path-filtered and deliberately not required, because a required check that never runs blocks the PR. If applying through the API, strip this key first (jq 'del(._comment)') and send the result to the branch protection endpoint for main.
